feed.title: Trailing rivals, AbbVie scores win with dual-acting myeloma drug
feed.summary: AbbVie announced positive Phase 3 clinical trial results for its dual-acting multiple myeloma drug, etentamig, showing it extended progression-free survival compared to standard treatments. The drug also demonstrated a better safety profile with lower rates of serious immune responses, potentially allowing for broader use in community oncology settings. This positions etentamig as a strong contender despite trailing rival bispecific antibodies from Johnson & Johnson, Pfizer, and Regeneron.

feed.title: Lululemon one of bigger victims in downside in athletic wear, says Wells Fargo’s Ike Boruchow
feed.summary: Wells Fargo senior retail analyst Ike Boruchow suggests that Lululemon is significantly impacted by the downturn in the athletic wear sector. This assessment comes after Lululemon reported another quarter of disappointing earnings and a sales slowdown, indicating ongoing struggles for the company. Boruchow's comments highlight Lululemon's vulnerability in the current market climate.

feed.title: Tesla Cybercabs face safety probe as regulators question driverless taxi compliance
feed.summary: Federal regulators have initiated an investigation into Tesla's new "Cybercab" driverless taxis, questioning their compliance with safety standards. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is examining whether the two-seater vehicles, which lack steering wheels, mirrors, or brake pedals, meet federal requirements. This probe comes just one day after Tesla launched the service in Austin, Texas, causing the company's stock to fall by over 5%.

feed.title: She boarded the ship. Her cruise was canceled before it ever set sail
feed.summary: A Royal Caribbean cruise to Alaska was canceled due to a mechanical issue after passengers had already embarked, leaving them stranded in Vancouver. The cruise line offered full refunds and future cruise credits, but passengers faced difficulties rebooking travel arrangements. This incident follows a similar cancellation by Disney Cruise Line in May, highlighting that while rare, such events do occur.

feed.title: Tenaya Therapeutics to Participate in Upcoming September Investor Conferences
feed.summary: Tenaya Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, announced its participation in two upcoming investor conferences in September: the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference and the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference. Management will host investor meetings, and a fireside chat from the H.C. Wainwright conference will be available on demand. The company will discuss its pipeline of therapies for heart disease, including gene therapies for HCM and ARVC, and a small molecule inhibitor for HFpEF and DMD.

feed.title: Western Digital (WDC) Down 2.2% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
feed.summary: Western Digital (WDC) shares have dropped 2.2% since its last earnings report, underperforming the S&P 500. Despite this, the company reported strong Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings, beating estimates with significant revenue growth driven by increased customer storage demand, especially for AI and cloud-driven needs. The company also provided encouraging guidance for Q1 fiscal 2027, expecting continued revenue growth and improved margins, leading to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

feed.title: Adobe Sinks 7% as Internal CEO Pick Lands Ahead of Earnings, Workday Falls 4%
feed.summary: Adobe's stock fell 7% after the company named an internal candidate, Anil Chakravarthy, as its new CEO, raising doubts about its AI strategy ahead of its earnings report. Workday also dropped 4% in sympathy, despite strong subscription guidance. This market reaction suggests investors are more concerned with Adobe's specific succession and AI narrative than broader software industry fundamentals, especially given Intuit's recent strong performance.

feed.title: ONEOK (OKE) is Funding a $4.4B Acquisition With a $9B Minority Investment. Is the 7% Capped Return Attractive?
feed.summary: ONEOK (OKE) is acquiring Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.425 billion, funded by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from Apollo-managed funds. This investment has an internal rate of return (IRR) capped at 7.0% for nine years. The article discusses the financial structure, potential benefits like reduced debt and EPS accretion, and potential risks such as the competing claim on cash flow and the reliance on aggressive growth forecasts for the acquired assets.

feed.title: Leftovers: Hershey’s fills up on fillings | Red Baron brings new spark to microwave pizza
feed.summary: Hershey's is introducing new Creme Bars with creamy fillings in Salted Caramel and Affogato flavors, building on its innovation in the sweets business. Red Baron is launching Crunchtime, a 10-inch microwaveable pizza designed for convenience without sacrificing quality, responding to increased consumer demand for at-home meals. Additionally, Monster's energy drink brand Flrt, targeted at women, is releasing its first flavor innovation, Apple Bottoms Up, which includes functional ingredients beyond caffeine.

feed.title: Market Movers RX: Regeneron and McKesson Lead Gainers
feed.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals and McKesson Corporation are leading the gainers in the latest "Market Movers RX" report. This update highlights significant movements in the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors. The article focuses on their performance as top gainers.

feed.title: ONEOK (OKE) is Funding a $4.4B Acquisition With a $9B Minority Investment. Is the 7% Capped Return Attractive?
feed.summary: ONEOK (OKE) is acquiring Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.425 billion, funded by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from Apollo-managed funds. This investment is structured with a 7% capped internal rate of return (IRR) for nine years. The article analyzes the bull and bear cases for this financing structure, concluding that the attractive return for ONEOK depends on rapid cash generation, successful integration of the acquired assets, and the entire portfolio's ability to exceed the minority return while funding capital needs and shareholder distributions.

feed.title: Experian expands into AI agents with ServiceNow partnership
feed.summary: Experian is expanding its artificial intelligence capabilities by partnering with ServiceNow to deploy a commercial agent-based platform called Agent Operating System. This system aims to integrate Experian's risk, identity, and decision-making services into enterprise workflows, improving efficiency and enabling faster information delivery. Experian emphasizes the secure and controlled nature of its AI agents, ensuring compliance and human oversight, especially in regulated processes.

feed.title: Can TROW's New Securitized Income ETF Boost Fixed-Income Growth?
feed.summary: T. Rowe Price Group (TROW) has launched the T. Rowe Price Securitized Income ETF (TSCZ) to expand its active ETF offerings, aiming to generate income and diversify fixed-income exposure. This new ETF invests in various U.S. securitized credit assets, strengthening TROW's presence in the securitized-credit market. The move is part of TROW's larger strategy to grow its active ETF business, supported by its recent acquisition of F/m Investments LLC, which is expected to significantly increase its fixed-income AUM and ETF offerings.

feed.title: Gilead Keeps Writing Bigger Checks—But Can the Drugs Keep Paying for Them?
feed.summary: Gilead Sciences continues to increase its dividend, supported by strong free cash flow, particularly from its HIV drug Biktarvy. While the company's dividend safety is rated B+ due to its reliable payouts and an extended patent runway for Biktarvy until 2036, it faces concentration risk in its HIV franchise. Gilead is actively working to diversify its revenue through its pipeline, with growth seen in PrEP sales, oncology drug Trodelvy, and liver disease treatment Livdelzi, aiming to build a bridge beyond the eventual patent cliff.

feed.title: Ternium (NYSE:TX) Hits New 1-Year High on Analyst Upgrade
feed.summary: Ternium (NYSE:TX) shares recently hit a new 52-week high after JPMorgan Chase & Co. raised its price target for the stock to $67.50 and maintained an "overweight" rating. The company has an overall "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts with an average target price of $54.50. Ternium reported $1.80 earnings per share and $4.34 billion in revenue in its last quarterly results, with institutional investors and hedge funds owning 11.98% of the company's stock.

feed.title: Lodging Lowdown: Mews launches POS in North America, Borgata announces $107M tower renovation project
feed.summary: This edition of Lodging Lowdown highlights Mews launching its POS system in the U.S. and Canada, offering hotels a unified platform for property management, payments, and F&B operations. Additionally, MGM Resorts International's Borgata Hotel Casino & Spa is embarking on a $107 million renovation of its tower, with work beginning on September 13th and renovated rooms available in October. The article also covers Hotel Equities partnering with Lodgic Hospitality to manage a three-hotel portfolio in Austin, Texas, expanding its presence in the competitive market.

feed.title: Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) Stock Price Expected to Rise, Wells Fargo & Company Analyst Says
feed.summary: Wells Fargo & Company has increased its price target for Merck & Co., Inc. (NYSE:MRK) to $170 from $150, maintaining an "overweight" rating and suggesting a 12.5% upside. This positive outlook is echoed by other analysts, with 15 rating the stock a "Buy" and eight a "Hold," leading to a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating. Merck's recent quarterly revenue of $16.61 billion surpassed expectations, showing a 5.1% year-over-year growth.

feed.title: General Mills closes sale of Brazil food business
feed.summary: General Mills has completed the sale of its Brazil food business to Grupo 3corações for $153 million, as part of its Accelerate strategy to reshape its product portfolio. The divestiture includes popular brands like Yoki and Kitano, and aims to increase General Mills' operating profit margin and allow its international segment to focus on more profitable global platforms. Grupo 3corações, Brazil's largest coffee company, expects the acquisition to significantly expand its industrial, logistics, and commercial capabilities across Brazil.

feed.title: TILLY'S (NYSE: TLYS) Reports $34.483M E-Commerce Revenue in Latest Quarter
feed.summary: TILLY'S (NYSE: TLYS) reported a significant increase in its latest quarterly net sales, reaching $163.508 million, up from $151.256 million in the prior year. The company returned to profitability with a net income of $8.381 million, driven by strong growth in both retail-store sales ($129.025 million) and e-commerce revenue ($34.483 million). Gross profit also improved to $58.095 million, with a gross margin of 35.5% of net sales.

feed.title: Titan Machinery (NASDAQ: TITN) Reports Q2 Revenue Decline to $496M and $9.15M Net Loss
feed.summary: Titan Machinery (NASDAQ: TITN) reported a significant decline in its Q2 revenue, falling to $496.384 million from $546.426 million in the prior year. The company also posted a net loss of $9.15 million, resulting in a basic and diluted loss per share of $0.40 for the quarter ending July 31, 2026. This downturn was primarily attributed to a decrease in equipment sales, though rental and other revenues saw an increase.

feed.title: Elevance Health (NYSE:ELV) Valuation Gap Persists After Rally
feed.summary: Elevance Health (NYSE:ELV) continues to exhibit a valuation gap despite a recent rally, trading below broader healthcare benchmarks. The article highlights that while strong market performance has narrowed this gap, the company's valuation remains central to discussions, influenced by factors like AI expansion, behavioral health services, cost management, and regulatory environment. The nuanced situation suggests that a low valuation doesn't automatically imply an overlooked business but can reflect concerns about future growth and operational complexities.

feed.title: One to Grow On by Dave “Persue” Ross | Paint the Nation | America250
feed.summary: Artist Dave “Persue” Ross created a mural titled "One to Grow On" for America's 250th birthday celebration, blending graffiti, skateboarding, and pop art elements with iconic Americana and Coca-Cola imagery. The centerpiece is a birthday cake with "250" candles, symbolizing the historic milestone. This mural is part of Coca-Cola's "Paint the Nation" campaign, which features various murals across the country to spark joy and encourage community celebration.

feed.title: CF Industries (NYSE: CF) Announces Chief Accounting Officer Richard A. Hoker's Retirement Effective March 3, 2027
feed.summary: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CF) announced that Richard A. Hoker, Vice President, Corporate Controller, and Chief Accounting Officer, will retire on March 3, 2027. Hoker notified the company of his plans on August 31, 2026. This announcement provides a clear timeline for the departure of a key senior finance executive.

feed.title: Linde stock price target reaffirmed at $612 by UBS on cost cuts
feed.summary: UBS has reiterated a Buy rating and a $612 price target for Linde (NASDAQ:LIN), citing the company's strategic discussions with its CFO and investor relations team. Despite the stock being considered overvalued by InvestingPro, UBS expects double-digit EPS growth by 2027 due to improving volumes and backlog contributions, alongside successful cost-cutting measures in its Lincare business. The reaffirmed target comes after Linde reported better-than-expected Q2 2026 earnings, though challenges in Lincare and margin concerns were noted by other analysts.

feed.title: Federal Regulators Open Investigation After Tesla Launches Car With No Steering Wheel
feed.summary: Federal regulators have opened an audit into Tesla's Cybercab, a new passenger vehicle launched without a steering wheel or pedals, after Tesla self-certified it as street-legal rather than going through the standard federal exemption process. This move bypasses the lengthy Part 555 exemption process typically required for vehicles not meeting all safety standards, a path previously taken by Zoox which took years. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is examining Tesla's certification process and technical data, especially how the company determined certain federal motor vehicle safety standards were inapplicable to the Cybercab.

feed.title: Here’s How Much You Would Have Made Owning Hilton Worldwide Holdings Stock In The Last 10 Years
feed.summary: Hilton Worldwide Holdings (HLT) has significantly outperformed the market over the last decade, with an annualized return of 20.28%. An initial investment of $1000 in HLT stock 10 years ago would now be worth $6,271.51, demonstrating the powerful effect of compounded returns. The company currently holds a market capitalization of $70.74 billion.

feed.title: Linde stock price target reaffirmed at $612 by UBS on cost cuts
feed.summary: UBS has reiterated its Buy rating and $612 price target for Linde (NASDAQ:LIN), citing the company's strategic management of challenges in its healthcare (Lincare) and helium businesses. The firm anticipates strong double-digit earnings per share growth for Linde through 2027, driven by improving volumes and backlog contributions, despite the stock currently appearing overvalued by InvestingPro data. This follows Linde's recent Q2 2026 earnings beat, though some concerns remain about Lincare's margins.

feed.title: Target to Open 8 More Stores This Fall
feed.summary: Target Corporation is set to open eight new stores across Mississippi, New York, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia this fall, completing its plan for over 30 new stores in 2026. This expansion is supported by a $5 billion capital investment focusing on new stores, remodels, and enhanced customer service. The new locations emphasize Target's merchandising strengths, with many exceeding 125,000 square feet and offering enhanced food selections, Drive Up, Order Pickup, and same-day delivery services.

feed.title: US safety regulator probes Tesla's Cybercab
feed.summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has launched an inquiry into Tesla's driverless Cybercab, questioning the company's certification process for a vehicle lacking traditional controls like a steering wheel or pedals. This probe follows Tesla's commercial deployment of the Cybercab in Austin, Texas, and aims to evaluate the technical data and Tesla's rationale for deeming the vehicle compliant with federal safety standards despite its design. Tesla had previously certified the two-seater vehicle as meeting all applicable standards and plans to expand its deployment.

feed.title: NBA 2K27 is out worldwide with its first city where male and female characters play together
feed.summary: NBA 2K27 has launched globally, introducing a new co-ed City experience where players can create both male and female MyPLAYERs to compete side-by-side. The game features overhauled gameplay, a new MyCAREER Eras mode, a 100-year MyNBA Legacy, and platform-specific enhancements including a 60 FPS Performance Mode on Nintendo Switch 2 and NVIDIA DLSS 5 support for PC. Developed by Visual Concepts and published by 2K, it's available on PS5, XBOX Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2, with various editions and cover athletes like Victor Wembanyama and Caitlin Clark.

feed.title: Adobe (ADBE) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Reassess Freemium And AI
feed.summary: Adobe's fair value estimate has increased slightly to US$275.25, reflecting analyst model adjustments rather than a major shift. This update comes amidst mixed analyst reactions to Adobe's Q2 results, its freemium strategy, new AI products, and leadership changes. While some analysts are bullish on the freemium and AI push, others express concern about potential pricing power erosion from AI and lower-cost competitors, highlighting execution risks given ongoing leadership transitions.

feed.title: PulteGroup stock initiated with buy rating at StoneX, $148 target
feed.summary: StoneX has initiated coverage on PulteGroup Inc. (NYSE:PHM) with a buy rating and a $148 price target, citing the homebuilder's strong long-term sales growth, high return on equity, and robust balance sheet. The company focuses on affluent first-time and active adult buyers, and recently surpassed second-quarter earnings expectations. Other firms like Wolfe Research and Citizens have also issued positive ratings, reflecting a favorable outlook amid a resilient housing market.

feed.title: Frozen berries sold at Walmart stores in 16 states recalled over E. coli risk
feed.summary: Frozen Great Value Organic Triple Berry Blend sold at Walmart stores in 16 states, including Illinois, has been recalled due to potential E. coli contamination. This expanded recall follows an earlier one for frozen blueberries at Publix stores, which has been linked to 17 E. coli infections. Consumers are advised to throw away or return the product for a full refund, and specific lot codes and "Best If Used By" dates for the affected berries are provided.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley Takes Aim at X Accounts Posting Its Research
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley has filed Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) complaints against X (formerly Twitter) accounts for posting its proprietary research, leading to temporary locks for at least two users. The bank cited screenshots from its reports, including charts by chief US equity strategist Mike Wilson, as copyrighted material. Users like Ryan Detrick expressed frustration, stating they would have removed the content if contacted directly, highlighting a clash between financial institutions protecting their research and the "Fintwit" community's practice of sharing market insights.

feed.title: Principal Financial (PFG) Moves 6.5% Higher: Will This Strength Last?
feed.summary: Principal Financial (PFG) shares climbed 6.5% after a trading session with notable volume, contrasting with its 3.1% loss over the past four weeks. The company benefits from a diversified mix of financial services, including recent acquisition of Beam Benefits, which supports recurring fees and asset under management growth. Despite this recent jump, a marginal downward revision in the consensus EPS estimate for the upcoming quarter suggests that the strength might not last, warranting continued monitoring of the stock.

feed.title: WWE Production Departments Reportedly Frustrated By Netflix Censorship Following Raw
feed.summary: WWE production departments are reportedly frustrated with Netflix over content censorship on "WWE Raw." This frustration stems from instances like blurring Jey Uso's bloodied face and censoring an expletive-laden promo by Jacob Fatu, contrary to expectations of less censorship with the Netflix partnership. Triple H even posted an uncensored version of an attack after Netflix's broadcast.

feed.title: Lululemon reports tough quarter, slashes outlook
feed.summary: Lululemon experienced a challenging quarter, with its North American sales continuing to decline, leading the company to lower its revenue and profit outlook for the year. The retailer also reduced its store opening plans amidst increased competition and inconsistent product launch responses. Heidi O’Neill is set to take over as CEO, facing the task of revitalizing the brand's performance in a crowded market.

feed.title: Is Marathon Petroleum Stock Still a Buy After More Than Doubling YTD?
feed.summary: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) has seen a 138.6% return year-to-date, outperforming peers and securing a spot as a top S&P 500 performer, driven by strong operational execution and strategic investments. Despite potential risks like cyclical refining margins and a premium valuation, the company's robust cash flow, shareholder returns, and positive earnings momentum make it an attractive investment, meriting a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy). Investors should consider its strong fundamentals against commodity-driven risks.

feed.title: Rollins Inc stock hits 52-week low at 35.31 USD By Investing.com
feed.summary: Rollins Inc. stock has hit a new 52-week low of $35.31, currently trading slightly above this mark. Analysts from Piper Sandler, Wells Fargo, and JPMorgan have consequently lowered price targets or downgraded the stock due to these concerns and increased market volatility.

feed.title: McDonald's Trades at 19.15X P/E: Is This a Discounted Opportunity?

Analysts expect continued revenue and EPS growth, but the stock currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) due to U.S. weakness.

This performance reflects challenges in the energy sector, prompting investors to closely monitor the stock's future trajectory.

feed.title: AbbVie’s Humira Cash Cow Is Shrinking—Can Its Dividend Keep Growing?
feed.summary: AbbVie's dividend continues to grow despite the significant decline in Humira sales, thanks to substantial free cash flow. The company is relying on newer drugs like Skyrizi and Rinvoq to offset Humira's lost revenue, but Skyrizi faces its own patent expiration in 2033. While the recent Apogee acquisition adds leverage and dilutes EPS, management aims to reduce net leverage within three years.

feed.title: Chipotle begins expansion into Asia with Seoul debut
feed.summary: Chipotle has launched its first Asian location in Seoul, South Korea, in partnership with Sangmidang Holdings, a major food brand operator. This expansion marks a significant step in the company's international growth strategy, with plans for more South Korean stores and a Singapore debut by 2027. Chipotle aims to leverage South Korea's discerning consumer base and strong restaurant culture for its Asian market entry.

feed.title: Why is Seagate Technology stock rallying today? By Investing.com
feed.summary: Seagate Technology stock is rallying, bouncing off its support zone after a recent decline, fueled by factors including structurally tighter hard disk drive supply, sustained nearline demand from hyperscale and cloud customers, and the expectation of firmer contract pricing. Analyst price targets have been raised, and a quarterly dividend payment is attracting income-oriented buyers, all contributing to the stock's outperformance despite a sideways broader market.

feed.title: Fair Isaac Shares Tumble on Federal Housing Finance Agency Directive Opening Doors for VantageScore
feed.summary: Fair Isaac (FICO) shares dropped significantly after the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) mandated Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to accept VantageScore for mortgage lenders, ending FICO's credit scoring monopoly in the mortgage sector. This regulatory change poses a direct threat to FICO's revenue, intensifying competition and raising concerns about its valuation and future growth prospects. The move follows previous downgrades and insider sales, further amplifying investor uncertainty.

feed.title: Ternium SA ADR stock hits all-time high at 58.5 USD

Despite this, InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock remains undervalued. feed.title: Toyota and Hyundai unable to travel to Rally Saudi Arabia
feed.summary: Toyota and Hyundai have informed the FIA and WRC Promoter that they cannot travel to Rally Saudi Arabia due to company-wide travel restrictions in certain Middle Eastern locations. Both manufacturers cited internal policies prohibiting travel to the region where the final World Rally Championship round is scheduled. Despite this, the FIA is actively working to find a solution to ensure the event proceeds.
